timingRule: First timestamped nonempty text emission that provides a correct requested fact, explanation, or committed-memory outcome; ignore greeting, thinking/search preamble and unsuccessful/incorrect replies. Review all task state. Fixed controls determine latency acceptance; cold starts separate. At least five distinct correct control scenarios and two completed correct repeats per scenario in both arms are required; otherwise timing is inconclusive.
criticalPolicy: Any unwanted write attempt/mutation, provenance corruption, or false save claim rejects a candidate. Retain all observed failures; no adaptive reroll.
qualification: Plan gates unchanged; best observed candidate is reported even if no candidate qualifies.
